title: Corinna Jane unleashes the haunting beauty of “Demons” and its a soundtrack that cuts deep
htmlContent: Corinna Jane's latest single, "Demons," is a captivating piece featured as the official soundtrack for the film "Mr Hyde: The Untold Story," this haunting song beautifully captures the film's intense emotions while standing out on its own. Written and produced by Corinna Jane, with help from engineer Luke Wood, "Demons" masterfully tells a story through sound. The music's dark tones, paired with her enchanting voice, reflect the complex nature of the characters Jekyll and Hyde. There's an emotional rawness in Jane's performance that transforms "Demons" into a powerful exploration of inner struggles. The thoughtful production allows her lyrics to shine through with striking clarity. This track enhances the film, making the viewing experience even more impactful. https://open.spotify.com/track/0F5370KhMQf7vHEoJtkt3b?si=pl13-pcCTn-WpVsDFDHdnQ Jane and Luke Wood have crafted the score for "Mr Hyde: The Untold Story," showcasing their talent for creating emotional music. "Demons" is a bold expression of Corinna Jane's skill in conveying feelings through music, skillfully blending the worlds of music and film. Check her out on: Facebook/Instagram
